capabilities: add inline comments to selected text
browse comments in a panel grouped by hierarchical tags
search comments and navigate to their source
extract the original note with links to a comments note
toggle comments between inline and block form
extras: Installation via BRAT or manual release files is documented; a Russian readme and an Obsidian forum thread are linked. The author solicits donations via Buy Me a Coffee. Lists future features (multiline comments, vault-wide comments tab) as not yet implemented.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to annotate text selections with searchable inline comments organized by tag hierarchies.

relations.evidence: Implementation has been based on the Obsidian Quiet Outline plugin.
Basic idea has been taken from the Comments plugin.

summary: Adds inline HTML and native %%comments%% to selected text while reading, and groups them in a panel by hierarchical tags.
